_comment: Reference list only — a starting point for what to search, NOT current prices or offers. Always verify live (see SKILL.md Step 2). Update this file occasionally as new providers/bundle types emerge.

mobile_carriers.name: T-Mobile
mobile_carriers.known_bundle_pattern: Historically bundles streaming perks (e.g. Netflix, Apple TV+, MLB.TV) into higher-tier unlimited plans; also runs T-Mobile Tuesdays weekly freebies. Search separately for any current switch/sign-up cash bonus — carriers usually run that as a distinct promo from the included-perk program. Verify live.

mobile_carriers.name: Verizon
mobile_carriers.known_bundle_pattern: myPlan perks system lets customers add streaming perks (e.g. Disney Bundle, Netflix/Max) for a flat add-on price or free on top tiers. Verizon also regularly runs a rotating gift-card bonus for switching with a new line/device — search for that separately, it's not listed on the same page as the streaming perks. Verify both live.

mobile_carriers.name: AT&T
mobile_carriers.known_bundle_pattern: Has periodically included streaming credits/bundles (e.g. HBO Max in the past) on unlimited plans, and DIRECTV STREAM bundle promos. Verify current offer live — this has changed multiple times and may currently be discontinued. Also check for a separate switch/sign-up cash bonus.

mobile_carriers.name: Google Fi
mobile_carriers.known_bundle_pattern: Has periodically bundled YouTube Premium/Music or Google One storage with certain plans. Verify live.

mobile_carriers.name: Xfinity / Comcast
mobile_carriers.known_bundle_pattern: Runs a pick-your-own streaming bundle (branded 'StreamSaver' as of late 2026) on top of Internet/TV service, plus separate student and general switch bonuses (gift cards, waived fees) on Xfinity Mobile and Gig WiFi. Check the mobile plan, the home internet plan, and the deals/promos page separately — they don't all live in one place. Verify live.

mobile_carriers.name: Spectrum Mobile / Charter
mobile_carriers.known_bundle_pattern: Charter/Spectrum internet plans have occasionally included a free streaming perk (e.g. Disney+ or Paramount+ for a promo period). Verify live.

membership_bundles.name: Amazon Prime
membership_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Bundles free/fast shipping with Prime Video, Amazon Music, Prime Gaming, Prime Reading, and periodic Whole Foods/Grubhub discounts. One membership, many perks — worth checking as its own bundle, not just for Prime Video.

membership_bundles.name: Walmart+
membership_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Has included Paramount+ as part of the membership in addition to free shipping and gas discounts. Verify current inclusion live — bundled service has changed before.

membership_bundles.name: Costco Membership
membership_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Executive membership tier adds 2% reward on purchases, plus access to Costco Travel and discounted gift cards for streaming/gift subscriptions sold in warehouses. Not a streaming bundle itself, but a common 'daily life' membership worth checking for current promos.

membership_bundles.name: Sam's Club Membership
membership_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Similar to Costco — membership perks plus discounted gift card promos. Verify current offers live.

membership_bundles.name: Uber One
membership_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Bundles discounts/free delivery across Uber Eats and Uber rides into one membership. Sometimes offered free for a period via credit card or carrier promos.

membership_bundles.name: DoorDash DashPass
membership_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Free delivery/reduced fees on DoorDash; frequently included free with certain credit cards (e.g. Chase) or other memberships (has been bundled with Amazon Prime in some periods). Verify current bundling partners live.

membership_bundles.name: Instacart+
membership_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Free delivery membership; has been bundled with some credit cards and occasionally with Peacock. Verify live.

productivity_bundles.name: Apple One
productivity_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Bundles Apple Music, Apple TV+, Apple Arcade, iCloud+ storage, and (on higher tiers) News+ and Fitness+ into one subscription at a discount vs buying separately. Individual/Family/Premier tiers — verify current pricing live.

productivity_bundles.name: Google One
productivity_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Bundles cloud storage with a VPN (on some tiers) and Google AI Pro features; family sharing included on paid tiers. Verify current tier pricing and inclusions live.

productivity_bundles.name: Microsoft 365 Family
productivity_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Bundles Office apps with OneDrive storage for up to 6 people; has occasionally included Xbox Game Pass promos. Verify live.

credit_card_bundles.name: Amex Platinum
credit_card_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Statement credits toward Walmart+, Uber Cash (covers Uber One in part), a 'Disney Bundle' streaming credit, CLEAR Plus, and other partner subscriptions. Terms/partners change often — verify current benefit list live.

credit_card_bundles.name: Chase Sapphire Reserve / Preferred
credit_card_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Has included DashPass (DoorDash) membership and Lyft/Peloton credits on some cards. Verify current card-specific benefits live — varies by exact card product.

credit_card_bundles.name: Capital One Venture X
credit_card_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Travel-focused credits/perks; occasionally includes streaming or delivery statement credits in promotions. Verify live.

credit_card_bundles.name: Amex / Chase Offers portals
credit_card_bundles.known_bundle_pattern: Personalized, account-specific statement-credit offers on streaming and other subscriptions. Can't be searched generically — the user needs to check their own card's offers portal.

stacking_categories: Student discounts (Spotify Premium Student often bundles Hulu; Amazon Prime Student; Apple Music Student often bundles Apple TV+)
Family/duo plan splitting for Spotify, YouTube Premium, Apple One, Amazon Prime, Microsoft 365 Family
Credit card offer portals (Amex Offers, Chase Offers) for statement credits on streaming/delivery/retail subscriptions
Annual vs monthly billing discounts on individual services
Discounted gift cards at warehouse clubs (Costco, Sam's Club) for streaming/gift subscriptions
Carrier weekly perk programs (e.g. T-Mobile Tuesdays) stacking with a carrier's included streaming perk
A retail/delivery membership (Walmart+, Amazon Prime) that already includes a streaming service, avoiding a separate subscription
